sourceTitle: An Enquiry into an Origin of Honour; and the Usefulness of Christianity in War
description: "An Enquiry into the Origin of Honour; and the Usefulness of Christianity in War" by Bernard Mandeville is a philosophical work likely written in the early 18th century. This treatise delves into the concept of honour's origins and its interplay with Christian ethics, particularly in the context of warfare.
